title: Built for hospitality workflows
text: Reservations, room status, folios, housekeeping, orders and kitchen tickets are core screens, not add-ons to a generic ERP.

title: Bangladesh-focused operations
text: Amounts in BDT (৳), cash and bKash recorded as payment methods in PetraDMS, and a team that works in your time zone.

title: Local deployment
text: PetraPMS runs on the property's own network, with its database on a server you control.

title: Connected by design
text: PMS, POS and DMS are planned around one shared data core. Each works on its own today; integrations are labelled until they ship.

title: Direct support
text: You speak to the people who build the software. Bug-fix support is included for three months after go-live.

title: Practical tools
text: Details from daily work: three-unit stock (big box, small box, piece), a compact mode with calculator, and dues on every invoice.
